audit.whatIsWrong: Hammer Shock is credited with a knockup and an auto-attack reset in four fields: whys[0] ('her Q knockup auto-reset'), spikes[0].text ('into her Q knockup'), content.early ('her Q knockup and auto resets'), wants.foe[0] ('follow with Q knockup') and wants.foe[1] ('into auto-reset patterns'). Hammer Shock does neither.
audit.why: Riot's Q text: 'Poppy swings her hammer, dealing damage and creating a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay.' Damage, a slow zone, and a delayed explosion — no displacement. Nothing in Poppy's kit carries an autoReset flag either. The delayed explosion is the actual mechanic worth knowing, because it is what punishes standing still after the stun, and the page never mentioned it once.
audit.corrected: All occurrences replaced with the slow zone and its delayed detonation.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.early says 'Poppy's Steadfast Presence aura passively reduces nearby dash effectiveness' and wants.foe[1] says she 'Stack[s] Steadfast Presence passive'. Neither describes the ability, and the dash clause is irrelevant in this matchup regardless.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence passively gives Poppy Armor and Magic Resist, and that bonus INCREASES when she is low on health — which is precisely the wrong direction for a Swain who is trying to finish a drain. The dash-stopping is the ACTIVE, and Swain has no dash in his kit, so it never applies here. It also does not stack. The mirror restated it as the armour/MR steroid from Poppy's side, so both pages now agree.
audit.corrected: content.early and wants.foe[1] rewritten around the resistance steroid that scales with her missing health.

audit.whatIsWrong: Keeper's Verdict is a channel and the page never says so, while whys[4] describes it as 'knock you out of Demonic Ascension mid-drain, negating your main survivability tool'.
audit.why: Riot's own R text uses the word: 'Poppy CHANNELS a hammer strike that knocks enemies very far away.' Two consequences the page missed. First, Nevermove's root cancels the channel outright — that is a 140s ultimate deleted by a 12s spell. Second, the displacement does not cancel Demonic Ascension; Swain's R is a transformation with no channel flag and Riot describes the form as indefinite while he drains. What actually happens is that she punts you out of the 650-unit drain radius, so the healing stops because there is nothing in range. The mirror made the identical correction from Poppy's side.
audit.corrected: whys[4] restated as displacement out of the 650 radius; dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[1].d now carry the channel-cancel and the radius.
sources: enemyKit R text and channel flag

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart rows 4 and 6 disagreed with the mirror in both layers.
audit.why: The mirror set row 4 to Poppy and row 6 to Swain and left row 3 on Skill. Row 4 belongs to Poppy because Keeper's Verdict removes the level-6 drain window that normally flips a lane for Swain; row 6 belongs to Swain because whys[6], spikes[3] and content.late all say stacked fragments plus R uptime finally outsustain her.
audit.corrected: Rows 4 and 6 flipped in both layers as one atomic group with ratings rescaled. Row 3 deliberately left on Skill to match the mirror — see questions.

audit.whatIsWrong: Heroic Charge is described only as 'Wall-pin stun' in three places with no range, no cooldown and no statement of the condition.
audit.why: Heroic Charge is a 475-range dash on 14/13/12/11/10s and it only stuns if the target is pushed INTO a wall — without terrain behind you it is a displacement and nothing more. That conditional is the entire counterplay and stating it turns 'dodge it' into 'stand in the middle of the lane'.
audit.corrected: tldr, dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and spikes[0].text now state the range, cooldown and the terrain condition.

audit.whatIsWrong: Iron Ambassador appears nowhere except an oblique 'Buckler trade cycles' in wants.you[2].
audit.why: Her passive throws a buckler that bounces off the target, and picking it back up grants her a shield — a burst absorber she controls the timing of. Denying or baiting the pickup is a real play against a champion whose burst window is short.
sources: enemyKit P text and shield flag

edits.before: Level 1 is a neutral farm phase — Poppy has no dash but her Q knockup and auto resets let her win short trades if you try to fight in melee range, so open with cautious W pokes at maximum range and do not walk up to auto. At level 2 the real danger begins: Heroic Charge is point-and-click movement toward you and will pin you against a wall for a full stun if there is terrain anywhere behind you, which is true on nearly every part of the top lane. Position toward the center of the lane at all times to deny the wall-pin, and only throw E when she has already burned Heroic Charge on a minion or a bad angle — landing your root when she still has Charge up just means she walks through it and stuns you mid-pull. Level 3 does not flip the lane despite giving you W: Poppy's Steadfast Presence aura passively reduces nearby dash effectiveness and your combo gap is short enough that she can Charge during your W windup if you are close enough to root. Accept that levels 1-3 belong to her and treat every trade as fragment fishing, not kill hunting.
edits.after: Level 1 is a neutral farm phase — Poppy has no dash but her Hammer Shock zone slows and then explodes if you try to fight in melee range, so open with cautious W pokes at maximum range and do not walk up to auto. At level 2 the real danger begins: Heroic Charge is point-and-click movement toward you and will pin you against a wall for a full stun if there is terrain anywhere behind you, which is true on nearly every part of the top lane. Position toward the center of the lane at all times to deny the wall-pin, and only throw E when she has already burned Heroic Charge on a minion or a bad angle — landing your root when she still has Charge up just means she walks through it and stuns you mid-pull. Level 3 does not flip the lane despite giving you W: Poppy's Steadfast Presence passively gives her armour and MR that climb as her health drops, and your combo gap is short enough that she can Charge during your W windup if you are close enough to root. Accept that levels 1-3 belong to her and treat every trade as fragment fishing, not kill hunting.

notes: Both entries in packet.suspectNames are FALSE POSITIVES on the name itself — 'Heroic Charge' and 'Steadfast Presence' are correct. The detector matched each against its own lowercase form. Ironically wants.foe[1] WAS wrong, just not for the reason flagged: the name is right and the mechanic was invented.
